name: Workspace List
description: Live Sandbox workspaces control panel. Top bar: shared-infra state with a Connect button, default k8s port-forward health (click to re-check), and the kube context with a switch-to-dev button. One always-expanded card per workspace: agent state (Needs you, Working, Done, Idle) with the last question, the work type, task title and issue, then Containers, PRs (state and CI), Workflow (stage or lifecycle step) and Agent rows. Each card's action bar runs the primary action (continue in Terminal, Up or Close out) and Stop / Restart / Down; its menu refreshes PRs, opens the feature or issue, shows logs, usage or an embedded Claude Code chat, and abandons with a reason. Close out and Abandon confirm inline. Filter by text or to the cards that need you.
